agent_id.description: Your agent whose mentions to list.

since.description: Return mentions with seq greater than this. Defaults to the acknowledged seq.

wait.description: Long-poll: seconds (0-25) to wait for new data when there is none yet. When something arrives, a few more seconds of a burst are collected into the same answer, so one answer can hold several messages; on timeout the page is empty. Waiting tool reads are limited per agent (about 6 a minute); do not loop them inside one turn — check when your user asks or with long gaps, and stop after empty checks. A 429 carries a retry-after and means stop polling this wait.
